dn8:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Ujuññāyaṃ viharati Kaṇṇakatthale miga-dāye.
dn8:1.3: Atha kho acelo Kassapo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
dn8:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ atthāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho acelo Kassapo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: 2.
dn8:2.2: "Samaṇo Gotamo sabban tapaṃ garahati, sabban tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadatīti."
dn8:2.3: Ye te bho Gotama evam āhaṃsu: "Samaṇo Gotamo sabban tapaṃ garahati, sabban tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadatīti," kacci te bho Gotamassa vutta-vādino, na ca Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati?
dn8:2.4: Anabbhakkhātukāmā hi mayaṃ bhavantam Gotaman ti.' 3.
dn8:3.1: ‘Ye te Kassapa evam āhaṃsu: "Samaṇo Gotamo sabban tapaṃ garahati, sabban tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadatīti," na me te vutta-vādino, abbhācikkhanti ca pana man te asatā abhūtena.
dn8:3.2: Idhāhaṃ Kassapa ekaccan tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ passāmi, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkanta-mānusakena . . . pe . . . kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppannaṃ.
dn8:3.3: Idha panāhaṃ Kassapa ekaccaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ passāmi dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkanta-mānusakena . . . pe . . . kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppannaṃ.
dn8:3.4: Idhāhaṃ Kassapa ekaccaṃ tapassiṃ appa-dukkha-vihāriṃ passāmi dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkanta-mānusakena . . . pe . . . kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppannaṃ.
dn8:3.5: Idha panāhaṃ Kassapa ekaccaṃ tapassiṃ appa-dukkha-vihāriṃ passāmi dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkanta-mānusakena . . . pe . . . kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppannaṃ.
dn8:3.6: Yo 'haṃ Kassapa imesaṃ tapassīnaṃ evaṃ āgatiñ ca gatiñ ca cutiñ ca uppattiñ ca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāmi, so 'haṃ kiṃ sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahissāmi, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosissāmi upavadissāmi? 4.
dn8:4.1: ‘Santi Kassapa eke samaṇa-brāhmaṇā paṇḍita nipuṇā kata-para-ppavādā vāla-vedhirūpā vobhindantā maññe caranti paññā-gatena diṭṭhi-gatāni.
dn8:4.2: Tehi pi me saddhiṃ ekaccesu ṭhānesu sameti, ekaccesu ṭhānesu na sameti.
dn8:4.6: Yan te ekaccaṃ vadenti "na sādhūti," mayaṃ pi taṃ ekaccaṃ vadema "na sādhūti." Yan te ekaccaṃ vadenti "sādhūti," mayan taṃ ekaccaṃ vadema "na sādhūti." Yan te ekaccaṃ vadenti "na sādhūti," mayan taṃ ekaccaṃ vadema "sādhūti."
dn8:4.7: Yaṃ mayaṃ ekaccaṃ vadema "sādhūti," pare pi taṃ ekaccaṃ vadenti
dn8:4.9: Yaṃ mayaṃ ekaccaṃ vadema "na sādhūti," pare pi taṃ ekaccaṃ vadenti "na sādhūti."
dn8:4.10: Yaṃ mayaṃ ekaccaṃ vadema "sādhūti," pare pi taṃ ekaccaṃ vadenti "na sādhūti." Yaṃ mayaṃ ekaccaṃ vadema "na sādhūti," pare pi taṃ ekaccaṃ vadenti "sādhūti." 5.
dn8:5.2: "Yesu no avuso ṭhānesu na sameti, tiṭṭhantu tāni ṭhānāni.
dn8:5.3: Yesu ṭhānesu sameti, tattha viññū samanuyuñjantaṃ samanugāhantaṃ samanubhāsantaṃ satthārā vā satthāraṃ saṃghena vā saṃghaṃ:
dn8:5.4: ‘Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā akusalā akusala- saṃkhātā , sāvajjā sāvajja-saṃkhātā asevitabbā asevitabba-saṃkhātā nālam-ariyā nālamariya-saṃkhātā kiṇhā kiṇha-saṃkhātā,
dn8:5.5: ko ime dhamme anavasesaṃ pahāya vattati, samaṇo vā Gotamo pare vā pana bhonto gaṇācariyā ti?' " 6.
dn8:6.1: ‘Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Kassapa vijjati yaṃ viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
dn8:6.2: "Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā akusalā akusala-saṃkhātā sāvajjā sāvajja-saṃkhātā asevitabbā asevitabbā-saṃkhātā nālam-ariyā nālamariya-saṃkhātā kiṇhā kiṇhā-saṃkhātā,
dn8:6.3: samaṇo Gotamo ime dhamme anavesasaṃ pahāya vattati, yaṃ vā pana bhonto pare gaṇācariyā ti."
dn8:6.4: Iti ha Kassapa viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā amhe va tattha yebhuyyena pasaṃseyyuṃ. 7.
dn8:7.1: ‘Aparam pi no Kassapa viññū samanuyuñjantaṃ samanugāhantaṃ samanubhāsantaṃ satthārā vā satthāraṃ saṃghena vā saṃghaṃ:
dn8:7.2: "Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā kusalā kusala-saṃkhātā anavajjā anavajja-saṃkhātā sevitabbā sevitabba-saṃkhātā alam-ariyā alamariya-saṃkhātā sukkā sukka-saṃkhātā,
dn8:7.3: ko ime dhamme anavasesaṃ samādāya vattati, samaṇo vā Gotamo, pare vā pana bhonto gaṇācariyā ti?" 8.
dn8:8.1: ‘Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Kassapa vijjati yaṃ viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
dn8:8.2: "Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā kusalā kusala-saṃkhātā anavajjā anavajja-saṃkhātā sevitabbā sevitabba-saṃkhātā alam-ariyā alamariya-saṃkhātā sukkā sukka-saṃkhātā,
dn8:8.3: samaṇo Gotamo ime dhamme anavasesaṃ samādāya vattati, yaṃ vā pana bhonto pare gaṇācariyā ti."
dn8:8.4: Iti ha Kassapa viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā amhe va tattha yebhuyyena pasaṃ seyyuṃ. 9
dn8:9.1: ‘Aparam pi no Kassapa viññū samanuyuñjantaṃ samanugāhantaṃ samanubhāsantaṃ satthārā vā satthāraṃ saṃghena vā saṃghaṃ:
dn8:9.2: "Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā akusalā akusala-saṃkhātā sāvajjā sāvajja-saṃkhātā asevitabbā asevitabba-saṃkhātā nālam-ariyā nālamariya-saṃkhātā kiṇhā kiṇha-saṃkhātā,
dn8:9.3: ko ime dhammā anavasesaṃ pahāya vattati, Gotama-sāvaka-saṃgho vā, pare vā pana bhonto gaṇācariya-sāvaka-saṃghā ti?" 10.
dn8:10.1: ‘Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Kassapa vijjati yaṃ viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ :
dn8:10.2: "Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā akusalā akusala-saṃkhātā sāvajjā sāvajja-saṃkhātā asevitabbā asevitabba-saṃkhātā nālam-ariyā nālamariya-saṃkhātā kiṇhā kiṇha-saṃkhātā, Gotama-sāvaka-
dn8:10.3: saṃgho ime dhamme anavasesaṃ pahāya vattati, yam vā pana bhonto pare gaṇācariya-sāvaka-saṃghā ti."
dn8:10.4: Iti ha Kassapa viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā amhe va tattha yebhuyyena pasaṃseyyuṃ. 11.
dn8:11.1: ‘Aparam pi no Kassapa viññū samanuyuñjantaṃ samanugāhantaṃ samanubhāsantaṃ satthārā vā satthāraṃ saṃghena vā saṃghaṃ:
dn8:11.2: "Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā kusalā kusala-saṃkhātā anavajjā anavajja-saṃkhātā sevitabbā sevitabba-saṃkhātā alam-ariyā alamariya-saṃkhātā sukkā sukka-saṃkhātā,
dn8:11.3: ko ime dhamme anavasesaṃ samādāya vattati, Gotama-sāvaka-saṃgho vā pare vā pana bhonto gaṇācariya-sāvaka-saṃghā ti?" 12.
dn8:12.1: ‘Ṭhānam kho pan' etaṃ Kassapa vijjati yaṃ viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
dn8:12.2: "Ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā kusalā kusala-saṃkhātā anavajjā anavajja-saṃkhātā sevitabbā sevitabba-saṃkhātā alam-ariyā alamariya-saṃkhātā sukkā sukka-saṃkhātā, Gotama-
dn8:12.3: sāvaka-saṃgho ime dhamme anavasesaṃ samādāya vattati, yaṃ vā pana bhonto pare vā gaṇācariya-sāvaka-saṃghā ti."
dn8:12.4: Iti ha Kassapa viññū samanuyuñjantā samanugāhantā samanubhāsantā amhe va tattha yebhuyyena pasaṃseyyuṃ . 13.
dn8:13.1: ‘Atthi Kassapa maggo, atthi paṭipadā, yathā paṭipanno sāmaṃ yeva ñassati sāmaṃ dakkhiti :
dn8:13.2: "Samaṇo Gotamo kāla-vadī bhūta-vādī attha-vādī dhamma-vādī vinaya-vādī ti."
dn8:13.3: Katamo ca Kassapa maggo, katamā paṭipadā, yathā paṭipanno sāmaṃ yeva ñassati sāmaṃ dakkhiti :
dn8:13.4: "Samaṇo va Gotamo kāla-vādī bhūta-vādī attha-vādī dhamma-vādī vinaya-vādī ti"?
dn8:13.6: seyyathīdaṃ sammā-diṭṭhi sammā-saṅkappo sammā-vācā sammā-kammanto sammā-ājīvo sammā-vāyāmo sammā-sati sammā-samādhi.
dn8:13.7: Ayaṃ kho Kassapa maggo, ayaṃ paṭipadā, yathā paṭipanno sāmaṃ yeva ñassati sāmaṃ dakkhiti : "Samaṇo va Gotamo kāla-vādī bhūta-vādī atthavādī dhamma-vādī vinaya-vādī ti."' 14.
dn8:14.1: Evaṃ vutte acelo Kassapo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn8:14.2: ‘Ime kho āvuso Gotama tapo-pakkamā ekesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sāmañña-saṃkhātā ca brāhmañña-saṃkhātā ca.
dn8:14.3: Acelako hoti muttācāro hatthāpalekhano, na-ehibhadantiko, na-tiṭṭha-bhadantiko, nābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakaṭaṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.
dn8:14.4: So na kumbhi-mukhā patigaṇhāti, na kaḷopi-mukhā patigaṇhāti, na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na purisantara-gatāya, na saṃkittisu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍa-saṇḍa-cārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ, na sūram na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pivati.
dn8:14.5: So ekāgāriko va hoti ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko, sattāgāriko vā hoti sattālopiko.
dn8:14.6: Ekissā pi dattiyā yāpeti, dvīhi pi dattīhi yāpeti, sattahi pi dattīhi yāpeti.
dn8:14.7: Ekāhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dvīhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, sattāhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, iti evarūpaṃ addha-māsikam pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharati.
dn8:14.8: Ime hi kho āvuso Gotama tapo-pakkamā ekesaṃ samaṇa-brāhmaṇānaṃ sāmañña-saṃkhātā ca brāhmaññasaṃkhātā ca.
dn8:14.9: Sāka-bhakkho vā hoti, sāmāka-bhakkho vā hoti, nīvāra-bhakkho vā hoti, daddula-bhakkho vā hoti, haṭa-bhakkho vā hoti, kaṇa-bhakkho vā hoti, ācāma-bhakkho vā hoti, piññāka-bhakkho vā hoti, tiṇabhakkho vā hoti, gomaya-bhakkho vā hoti, vana-mūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavatta-phala-bhojī. Ime
dn8:14.10: hi kho āvuso Gotama tapo-pakkamā ekesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānam sāmañña-saṃkhātā ca brāhmañña-saṃkhātā ca.
dn8:14.11: Sāṇāni pi dhāreti, masāṇāni pi dhāreti, chava-dussāni pi dhāreti, paṅsu-kūlāni pi dhāreti, tirīṭāni pi dhāreti, ajināni pi dhāreti, ajinakkhipam pi dhāreti, kusacīram pi dhāreti vākā-cīram pi dhāreti, phalaka-cīram pi dhāreti, kesa-kambalam pi dhāreti, vāla-kambalam pi dhāreti, ulūka-pakkham pi dhāreti.
dn8:14.15: kaṇṭakāpassayiko pi hoti kaṇṭakāpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti,
dn8:14.16: phalaka-seyyam pi kappeti, thaṇḍila-seyyam pi kappeti,
dn8:15.1: ‘Acelako ce pi Kassapa hoti muttācāro hatthāpalekhano . . . pe . . . iti evarūpaṃ addha-māsikam pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
dn8:15.2: tassa cāyaṃ sīla-sampadā citta-sampadā paññā-sampadā abhāvitā hoti asacchikatā, atha kho so ārakā va sāmaññā, ārakā va brahmaññā.
dn8:15.3: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:15.4: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pi.
dn8:15.5: Sāka-bhakkho ce pi Kassapa hoti, sāmāka-bhakkho ce pi Kassapa hoti, nīvāra-bhakkho . . . pe . . . vana-mūla-phalāhāro yāpeti pavatta-phala-bhojī,
dn8:15.6: tassa cāyaṃ sīla-sampadā citta-sampadā paññā-sampadā abhāvitā hoti asacchikatā,
dn8:15.7: atha kho so ārakā va sāmaññā ārakā va brahmaññā.
dn8:15.8: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:15.9: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pi.
dn8:15.10: Sāṇāni ce pi Kassapa dhāreti, masāṇāni pi dhāreti . . . pe . . .
dn8:15.12: tassa cāyaṃ sīlasampadā citta-sampadā paññā-sampadā abhāvitā hoti asacchikatā,
dn8:15.13: atha kho so ārakā va sāmaññā ārakā va brahmaññā.
dn8:15.14: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittam bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:15.15: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pīti.' 16.
dn8:16.1: Evaṃ vutte acelo Kassapo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn8:16.2: ‘Dukkaraṃ bho Gotama sāmaññaṃ, dukkaraṃ brahmaññan ti.'
dn8:16.3: ‘Pakati kho esā Kassapa lokasmiṃ "Dukkaraṃ sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan" ti.
dn8:16.4: Acelako ce pi Kassapa hoti, muttācāro hatthāpalekhano . . . pe . . . iti evarūpam addha-māsikam pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
dn8:16.5: imāya ca Kassapa mattāya iminā ca tapo-pakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā abhavissa brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, n' etam abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:16.7: Sakkā ca pan' etaṃ abhavissa kātuṃ gahapatinā va gahapati-puttena vā antamaso kumbha-dāsiyā pi:
dn8:16.8: "Handāhaṃ acelako homi muttācāro hatthāpalekhano . . . pe . . . iti evarūpaṃ addha-māsikam pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharāmīti."
dn8:16.9: Yasmā ca kho Kassapa aññatr' eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapo-pakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā hoti brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:16.11: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:16.12: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pi.
dn8:16.13: Sāka-bhakkho ce pi Kassapa hoti, sāmāka-bhakkho . . . pe . . . vana-mūla-phalāhāro yāpeti pavatta-phala-bhojī,
dn8:16.14: imāya ca Kassapa mattāya iminā ca tapo-pakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā abhavissa brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaram, n' etaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:16.16: Sakkā ca pan' etaṃ abhavissa kātuṃ gahapatinā vā gahapati-puttena vā antamaso kumbha-dāsiyā pi:
dn8:16.17: "Handāhaṃ sāka-bhakkho vā homi sāmāka-bhakkho . . . pe . . . vana-mūla-phalāhāro yāpemi pavatta-phalabhojī ti."
dn8:16.18: Yasmā ca kho Kassapa aññatr' eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapo-pakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā hoti brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:16.20: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:16.21: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pi.
dn8:16.22: Sāṇāni ce pi Kassapa dhāreti, masāṇāni pi dhāreti . . . pe . . . sāya-tatiyakam pi udakorohanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
dn8:16.23: imāya ca Kassapa mattāya iminā tapo-pakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā abhavissa brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, n' etaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:16.25: Sakkā ca pan' etaṃ abhavissa kātuṃ gahapatinā vā gahapati-puttena vā antamaso kumbha-dāsiyā pi:
dn8:16.26: "Handāhaṃ sāṇāni pi dhāremi, masāṇāni pi dhāremi . . . pe . . . sāya-tatiyakam pi udakorohanānuyogam anuyogo viharāmīti ."
dn8:16.27: Yasmā ca kho Kassapa aññatr' eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapo-pakkamena sāmaññaṃ vā hoti brahmaññaṃ vā dukkaraṃ sudukkaraṃ, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:16.29: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:16.30: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pīti.' 17.
dn8:17.1: Evaṃ vutte acelo Kassapo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn8:17.2: ‘Dujjāno bho Gotama samaṇo, dujjāno brāhmaṇo ti.'
dn8:17.3: ‘Pakati kho esā Kassapa lokasmiṃ "Dujjāno samaṇo, dujjāno brāhmaṇo ti."
dn8:17.4: Acelako ce pi Kassapa hoti, muttācāro hatthāpalekhano . . . pe . . . iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
dn8:17.5: imāya ca Kassapa mattāya iminā tapo-pakkamena samaṇo vā abhavissa brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno, n' etaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.7: Sakkā ca pan' eso abhavissa ñātuṃ gahapatinā vā gahapati-puttena vā antamaso kumbha-dāsiyā pi:
dn8:17.8: "ayaṃ acelako muttācāro hatthāpalekhano . . . pe . . . iti evarūpaṃ addha-māsikam pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharatīti."
dn8:17.9: Yasmā ca kho Kassapa aññatr' eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapo-pakkamena samaṇo vā hoti brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.11: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:17.12: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pi.
dn8:17.13: Sāka-bhakkho ce pi Kassapa hoti, sāmāka-bhakkho . . . pe . . . vana-mūla-phalāhāro yāpeti pavatta-phalabhojī,
dn8:17.14: imāya ca Kassapa mattāya iminā tapo-pakkamena samaṇo vā abhavissa brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno, n' etaṃ abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.16: Sakkā ca pan' eso abhavissa ñātuṃ gahapatinā vā gahapati-puttena vā antamaso kumbha-dasiyā pi,
dn8:17.17: "ayaṃ sāka-bhakkho sāmāka- bhakkho . . . pe . . . vana-mūla-phalāhāro yāpeti pavatta-phalabhojī ti."
dn8:17.18: Yasmā ca kho Kassapa aññatr' eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapo-pakkamena samaṇo vā hoti brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.20: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavam ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:17.21: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pi.
dn8:17.22: Sāṇāni ce pi Kassapa dhāreti, masāṇāni pi dhāreti . . . pe . . . sāyatatiyakam pi udakorohanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
dn8:17.23: imāya ca Kassapa mattāya iminā tapo-pakkamena samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā abhavissa dujjāno sudujjāno, n' etam abhavissa kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.25: Sakkā ca pan' eso abhavissa ñātuṃ gahapatinā vā gahapati-puttena vā antamaso kumbhadāsiyā pi:
dn8:17.26: "Ayaṃ sāṇāni pi dhāreti masāṇāni pi dhāreti . . . pe . . . sāya-tatiyakam pi udakorohanānuyogam anuyutto viharatīti."
dn8:17.27: Yasmā ca kho Kassapa aññatr' eva imāya mattāya aññatra iminā tapo-pakkamena samaṇo vā hoti brāhmaṇo vā dujjāno sudujjāno, tasmā etaṃ kallaṃ vacanāya
dn8:17.29: Yato kho Kassapa bhikkhu averaṃ avyāpajjhaṃ metta-cittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ ca khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
dn8:17.30: ayaṃ vuccati Kassapa bhikkhu Samaṇo iti pi Brāhmaṇo iti pīti.' 18.
dn8:18.1: Evaṃ vutte acelo Kassapo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn8:18.2: ‘Katamā pana sā bho Gotama sīla-sampadā, katamā citta-sampadā, katamā paññā-sampadā ti?'
dn8:18.3: ‘Idha Kassapa Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho . . . pe . . .
dn8:18.4: bhaya-dassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhā-padesu, kāyakamma- vacī-kammena samannāgato kusalena, parisuddhājīvo sīla-sampanno, indriyesu gutta-dvāro, sati-sampajaññena samannāgato, santuṭṭho.
dn8:18.6: Idha Kassapa bhikkhu pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihita-daṇḍo, nihita-sattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūta-hitānukampī viharati.
dn8:18.7: Idam pi 'ssa hoti sīla-sampadāya [yathā Sāmañña-phale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ] . . .
dn8:19.1: ‘Yathā vā pan' eke bhonto samaṇa-brāhmaṇā saddhā-deyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā, te eva-rūpāya tiracchāna-vijjāya micchā-jīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti,
dn8:19.2: seyyathīdaṃ santi-kammaṃ paṇidhi-kammaṃ . . . pe . . . osadhīnaṃ paṭimokkho
dn8:19.3: iti vā iti evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchā-jīvā paṭivirato hoti.
dn8:19.5: ‘Sa kho so Kassapa bhikkhu evaṃ sīla-sampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yad idam sīla-saṃvarato.
dn8:19.6: Seyyathā pi Kassapa rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto nihitapaccāmitto na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yad idaṃ paccatthikato,
dn8:19.7: evam eva kho Kassapa bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yad idaṃ sīla-saṃvarato.
dn8:19.8: So iminā ariyena sīla-kkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajja-sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
dn8:19.9: Evaṃ kho Kassapa bhikkhu sīla-sampanno hoti.
dn8:19.10: Ayaṃ kho sā Kassapa sīla-sampadā. 19. ‘Kathañ ca Kassapa bhikkhu indriyesu gutta-dvāro hoti? Idha Kassapa bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvāna nimittaggāhī hoti . . . pe . . .
dn8:19.11: manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. So iminā ariyena indriya-saṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ avyāseka-sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. Evaṃ kho Kassapa bhikkhu indriyesu gutta- dvāro hoti . . . pe . . . tass' ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanupassato pamojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jayati, pīti-manassa kāyo passambhati, passaddha-kāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati, so vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pīti-sukham paṭhama -jjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn8:19.12: So imam eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pīti-sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pīti-sukhena apphutaṃ hoti. Seyyathā pi Kassapa dakkho nahāpako vā nahāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsa- thale nahāniya- cuṇṇāni ākiritvā, udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya, sā h' assa nahāniya-piṇḍi snehānugatā sneha-paretā santara-bāhirā phuṭā snehena, na ca paggharaṇī -- evam eva kho Kassapa bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pīti-sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pīti-sukhena apphutaṃ hoti. Idam pi 'ssa hoti citta-sampadāya. ‘Puna ca paraṃ Kassapa bhikkhu vitakka-vicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodi-bhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . .
dn8:20.1: ‘So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudu-bhūte kammaniye ṭhite ānejjappatte
dn8:20.3: So evaṃ pajānāti: "Ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātā-pettika-sambhavo odāta-kummāsūpacayo aniccucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana- viddhaṃsana -dhammo, idañ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan ti." ‘Seyyathā pi Kassapa maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṅso suparikamma-kato accho vippasanno sabbākārasampanno, tatr' idaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍu-suttaṃ vā ti. Evam eva kho Kassapa bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudu-bhūte kammaniye ṭhite ānejjappatte ñāṇa-dassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. So evaṃ pajānāti: "Ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātā-pettika-sambhavo odātakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana viddhaṃsana -dhammo, idañ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan ti." Idam pi 'ssa hoti paññāsampadāya . . . pe . . .
dn8:20.7: Imāya ca Kassapa sīla-sampadāya citta-sampadāya paññā-sampadāya aññā sīla-sampadā citta-sampadā paññāsampadā uttaritarā vā paṇītatarā vā n' atthi. 21.
dn8:21.3: Yāvatā Kassapa ariyam paramaṃ sīlaṃ, nāhaṃ tattha attano sama-samaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhīyyo.
dn8:21.4: Atha kho aham eva tattha bhīyyo yadidaṃ adhisīlaṃ.
dn8:21.7: Yāvatā Kassapa ariyā paramā tapo-jigucchā nāhaṃ tattha attano sama-samaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhīyyo.
dn8:21.8: Atha kho aham eva tattha bhīyyo yadidaṃ adhijegucchaṃ.
dn8:21.11: Yāvatā Kassapa ariyā paramā paññā, nāhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhīyyo.
dn8:21.12: Atha kho aham eva tattha bhīyyo yadidam adhipaññā.
dn8:21.15: Yāvatā Kassapa ariyā paramā vimutti, nāhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhīyyo.
dn8:21.16: Atha kho aham eva tattha bhīyyo yadidam adhimutti. 22.
dn8:22.1: ‘Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Kassapa vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
dn8:22.2: "Sīha-nādaṃ kho Samaṇo Gotamo nadati, tañ ca kho suññāgāre nadati no parisāsūti."
dn8:22.3: Te "Mā h' evan" ti assu vacanīyā.
dn8:22.4: "Sīhanādañ ca Samaṇo Gotamo nadati, parisāsu ca nadatīti," evam assu Kassapa vacanīyā.
dn8:22.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Kassapa vijjati yam añña-titthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
dn8:22.6: "Sīha-nādañ ca Samaṇo Gotamo nadati, parisāsu ca nadati, na ca kho visārado
dn8:22.10: nadati." . . ..visārado ca nadati -- . . . pe . . . "na ca kho naṃ pañhaṃ pucchanti . . .
dn8:22.11: pañhañ ca naṃ pucchanti, -- . . . pe . . . "na ca kho pan' etaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho vyākaroti" . . .
dn8:22.12: "pañhañ ca nesaṃ puṭṭho vyākaroti" -- . . . pe . . . "na ca kho pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheti" . . . "pañhassa ca veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheti" -- . . . pe . . .
dn8:22.13: "na ca kho sotabbaṃ assa maññanti" . . . "sotabbaṃ c' assa maññanti" -- . . . pe . . .
dn8:22.14: "na ca kho sutvā pasīdanti" . . . "sutvā c' assa pasīdanti" -- . . . pe . . .
dn8:22.15: na ca kho pasannā pasannākāraṃ karonti" . . . "pasannā pasannākārañ ca karonti" -- . . . pe . . .
dn8:22.16: "na ca kho tathattāya paṭipajjanti" . . . "tathattāya ca paṭipajjanti" -. . . pe . . .
dn8:22.19: "Sīha-nādañ ca Samaṇo Gotamo nadati, parisāsu ca nadati, visārado ca nadati, pañhañ ca naṃ pucchanti, pañhañ ca nesaṃ puṭṭho vyākaroti, pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheti, sotabbañ c' assa maññanti, sutvā ca pasīdanti, pasannā ca pasannākāraṃ karonti, tathattāya ca paṭipajjanti, paṭipannā ca ārādhentīti," evam assu Kassapa vacanīyā. 23.
dn8:23.1: ‘Ekam idāhaṃ Kassapa samayaṃ Rājagahe viharāmi Gijjha-kūṭe pabbate.
dn8:23.2: Tatra maṃ aññataro tapasa-brahmacārī Nigrodho nāma adhijegucche pañhaṃ pucchi.
dn8:23.4: Vyākate ca pana me attamano ahosi, paraṃ viya mattāyāti.'
dn8:23.5: ‘Ko hi bhante Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā na attamano assa paraṃ viya mattāya?
dn8:23.6: Aham pi bhante Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā attamano paraṃ viya mattāya.
dn8:23.8: Seyyathā pi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā tela-pajjotaṃ dhāreyya: "Cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti," -- evam evaṃ Bhagavatā aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn8:23.9: Esāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhu-saṃghañ ca.
dn8:23.10: Labheyyāhaṃ bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan ti.' 24.
dn8:24.1: ‘Yo kho Kassapa añña-titthiya-pubbo imasmiṃ dhamma-vinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddha-citta bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhu-bhāvāya.
dn8:24.2: Api ca m' ettha puggala-vemattatā viditā ti.'
dn8:24.3: ‘Sace bhante añña-titthiya-pubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddha-cittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya, ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddha-cittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhu-bhāvāyāti.'
dn8:24.4: Alattha kho acelo Kassapo Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alatthūpasampadaṃ.
dn8:24.5: Acirūpasampanno kho pan' āyasmā Kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto, na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kula-puttā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tad anuttaraṃ brahma-cariya-pariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi: ‘
dn8:24.6: Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti ' abbhaññāsi.
dn8:24.7: Aññataro ca kho pan' āyasmā Kassapo arahataṃ ahosīti. 1.
